responsibility: Declares the initial top-level item-resolution visitor for the Rust frontend. TypeCheckTopLevel performs the early pass that seeds TypeCheckContext with TyTy types for visible items and impl contents before full item and body type checking runs.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TypeCheckTopLevel visitor used for the initial signature/shape pass over visible items, but not the code that constructs those early TyTy entries. That implementation is in rust-hir-type-check-toplevel.cc.
